description: Prepare a short-lived Instagram approval link for this profile, only when a person asks to connect or reconnect it. Admin only. Return the URL to that person; they must open it and approve on Meta. This call connects nothing, calls no external service and costs no credits. The URL expires at expiresAt and returns to this profile's Instagram screen in SmartGenius. Treat it as a private authorization link: never publish it. Approval can replace the current account, remove its imported history and cancel its schedules. Revoking the issuing API key stops new connections, not cleanup already started or connections already saved. Call again if it expires. It accepts no requestId or return URL, and its answer is not saved for replay. For another of a brand's Instagram accounts, pass that account's id from list_brands as `profile`.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

name: get_instagram_connect_link
title: Get an Instagram connection link
